responsibility: Declares the diagnostics selftest entry points, both the umbrella runner and the per-source-file test families. It is the shared registration header that lets GCC’s checking build invoke diagnostics-specific tests such as color, context, file-cache, sink, path, and state-graph tests without embedding those declarations in production-facing subsystem headers.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the diagnostics-selftests pair: it provides prototypes for the umbrella diagnostics selftest runner and the individual *_cc_tests functions from diagnostics sources. Unlike diagnostics-selftests.cc, it does not dispatch or run those tests.
